name: Kings Kush - Essentials - 1G
description:
King’s Kush is an indica strain made by crossing OG Kush with Grape. King’s Kush produces gradual, yet powerful effects that will make you feel relaxed and euphoric. This strain features a flavor profile that is similar to a tangy grape with undertones of lavender. King’s Kush is a great choice to relieve symptoms associated with insomnia.

Taste: Tangy, Citrus, Grape
Feel: Creative, Social, High Energy
Strain: OG Kush x Grape
